status: draft source only; not compiled/native-tested/deployed; strict validation requires prior issuer rollout and retirement of unbound tokens
protocol: Each API validates signature/issuer/audience/lifetime and exact bound session before publishing request identity. WEB4 retains independent offline-grant endpoint policy without authenticating an invalid bearer. WEB6 now requires its first authoritative avatar/session lookup.
rolloutRequirement: Do not deploy strict validators until acknowledged issuer source is deployed on all issuers and the maximum old configured access lifetime has elapsed; no permanent unbound-token bypass.
ordering: WEB5 and WEB7-WEB10 originally ran framework authorization before JWT middleware; moved it immediately after successful-session middleware. WEB4 keeps its existing validated-principal bridge ordering, WEB6 already has correct order.
availabilityLimit: Authoritative revocation reads cannot currently fail over to an unproven stale credential replica. This batch does not prove cross-provider session failover; that remains part of the active HyperDrive programme.
consumerAudit: WEB5/7-10 have no direct NameIdentifier or Identity.Name consumers in their API source. WEB6 AdminActor was the one mapped-subject consumer; changed it to the shared canonical validated subject, avoiding bearer audit misattribution as api-key.
nextVerification: Compile all seven actual API projects on the latest verified foundation graph under one bounded lease.
Exercise real middleware/HTTP authorization with actual native issued, rotated and revoked credentials; preserve independent sessions and reject inconsistent subjects.
Verify WEB4 independent signed offline-grant authorization remains separate from failed bearer identity; preserve canonical WEB6 audit attribution.
Check current dev rollout queue and exact running issuer source before any staged deployment; retire old configured token lifetimes before strict enforcement.
Global/selected logout and cross-provider session freshness/failover are still unfinished; keep OPORTAL controls disabled until real acceptance.
